audit.gap_or_expiry: publish partial/unknown with explicit unverifiable boundary; never bridge or renew by assertion
audit.mismatch: persist evidence and block ClickHouse only; capture and archive continue
audit.oversized_unit: persist column offset plus hash-state version and resume; reject if one encoded scalar exceeds event contract
audit.payload_only_corruption: must be detected even when connector_event_id, stored payload_hash and batch marker are unchanged
audit.payload_verification: read actual stored key, operation, full source version, relation schema and tagged column values; recompute canonical payload hash; compare recomputed hash with stored payload_hash and retained journal hash
audit.target: frozen finite checkpoint and selector/object identity

confirmation.scope: every pre-filled RECOMMENDED default accepted exactly

event_projection.dedup: same connector_event_id and payload_hash collapses logically; same ID with multiple hashes blocks
event_projection.delete: latest event delete hides row but tombstone remains in history
event_projection.key_change: old complete key delete plus new complete key upsert; unchanged_toast anywhere blocks
event_projection.toast: latest explicit_value or explicit_null per column is carried through unchanged_toast; absent_for_schema projects null; missing predecessor blocks

failure_and_observability.redaction: never payload, canonical key, raw identifier, DSN, credential, raw error, nonce or absolute path
failure_and_observability.resume: explicit; corrected cause plus unchanged failed boundary revalidated

quota.hard_action: block ClickHouse only before insert; never delete history

required_proof: generation is not unique greatest live selector
no replay, audit, anchor, intent or reader pin

insert_acceptance.ambiguous: no marker means replay exact intent; valid marker means adopt; conflicting marker/history blocks
insert_acceptance.checkpoint: never advances before marker readback and never skips a failed journal transaction
ordered_steps: persist immutable batch intent and exact complete-transaction journal range
insert event_history_v1 with pinned settings and query_id=batch_id
drive Rust insert future/body to successful end-of-stream finalization
read back exact event count, unique IDs, ordered event digest and zero ID/hash conflicts
read back one identical marker and object fingerprint
commit destination checkpoint and finalized intent atomically in SQLite

lookup_behavior.canonical_join: query-time joins only among pinned local ClickHouse objects in the same capture_epoch/generation
lookup_behavior.display_names: non-correctness metadata only; logical_table_id and column_id drive grouping
lookup_behavior.external_dictionaries: forbidden for correctness and TOAST reconstruction

objects.materialized_view_policy: none: correctness is computed from append-only history; no independently failing derived write is accepted

promotion.external_ahead: block allocation until maintenance verifies/adopts highest external fence or rejects
promotion.selector: append-only generation_selectors_v1; canonical queries resolve unique greatest promotion_fence

schema_evolution.active_backfill: invalidate candidate and require fresh generation
schema_evolution.compatible: nullable non-generated no-default addition outside active backfill only; older absent_for_schema projects null
schema_evolution.incompatible: block whole ClickHouse destination at failed transaction and require complete fresh generation/reseed
schema_evolution.migration: maintenance creates versioned objects; dual-read verifies before contract-fingerprint adoption
schema_evolution.mutation_commands: UPDATE, DELETE, OPTIMIZE FINAL CLEANUP and TTL on history are forbidden
